title: KTTK Radio Dave Hutton Memorial Christmas Sing
seo_title: KTTK Radio Dave Hutton Memorial Christmas Sing, Lebanon MO
description: This is a Christmas sing held in memory of Dave Hutton, presented by KTTK Radio and featuring The Lesters, Potters Wheel, Becky & Lauryn Lercher, Brenda Rhodes & Kids, and The New Horizons, with Brian Lester and Don Anderson as emcees. It takes place Saturday, November 28, 2026 at 6:00 PM at Hillcrest Baptist Church, 399 Hoover Ave in Lebanon, MO, with doors opening at 5:00 PM. No tickets are needed, and a love offering is taken.
